policies.general: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging.
policies.electronics: Electronics can be returned within 14 days of delivery, unopened, for a full refund. Opened electronics are eligible for exchange only.
policies.clothingFootwear: Clothing and footwear can be returned within 30 days if unworn with tags attached.
policies.furniture: Furniture returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery. Customer covers return shipping unless the item arrived damaged.
policies.finalSale: Items marked 'Final Sale' at purchase cannot be returned or refunded.

returnReasons.label: Received the wrong item
returnReasons.resolution: Full refund or replacement, free return shipping.

returnReasons.label: Item arrived damaged
returnReasons.resolution: Full refund or replacement, free return shipping, no need to return the damaged item unless requested.

returnReasons.label: Changed my mind / no longer needed
returnReasons.resolution: Refund minus return shipping cost, subject to category policy above.

returnReasons.label: Wrong size or fit
returnReasons.resolution: Free exchange or refund, subject to category policy above.

returnReasons.label: Arrived too late
returnReasons.resolution: Full refund, free return shipping if item is unopened.

sampleCases.rejectionNote: Item marked Final Sale at time of purchase.

notFoundMessage: We couldn't find a return case with that order ID or case ID. You can start a new return request or contact support directly.
